faq.a: The library holds over a hundred quotes tagged by category and author, and attributions are handled carefully: quotes that are commonly misattributed are labelled as such (for example "Attributed to Eleanor Roosevelt" or "Paraphrase of Mahatma Gandhi"). A deep-dive note on the page explains how often quotations are misattributed and how to verify one, which is unusual honesty for a quote tool.

faq.q: Can I filter and search the quotes?
faq.a: Yes. Filter by category (motivation, study, success, leadership, wisdom, Indian leaders, science, sports, life, and more), filter by author, or search the text and author. A deterministic "Quote of the Day" shows the same quote to everyone on a given date. You can favourite quotes (saved locally), copy or share them, and export favourites as a .txt file.

faq.q: What can the image maker produce?
faq.a: It renders a quote onto a canvas at Instagram Square 1080×1080, Story 1080×1920, Twitter/X 1200×675, WhatsApp Status, or A4 Poster 2480×3508. Backgrounds can be a palette gradient, a solid colour, or your own uploaded image with an adjustable darkness overlay. You control text colour, alignment, font, font size (auto-shrinks to fit), and an optional watermark. Export as PNG, JPEG or WEBP with a quality slider.

Yes. "Download all as ZIP" renders every quote currently matching your filters (up to 60) as individual images in your chosen format and bundles them into a ZIP, with filenames numbered and slugged by author. Because one canvas is reused, each image is fully encoded before the next is drawn. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded, and JSZip loads only on first use.
